day_shape: 66 items: Mojtaba Khamenei issues six senior military appointments including new IRGC chief Ahmad Vahidi and Basij head Taeb, Iranian parliament advances Strait of Hormuz bill, UN warns Yemen nearing renewed war, nothing from OFAC or IAEA.

threads.label: Mojtaba Khamenei's military reshuffle decrees
threads.summary: Khamenei's office published decrees appointing Ahmad Vahidi as IRGC commander-in-chief, Ali Abdollahi as Armed Forces Chief of Staff, Mostafa Izadi as IRGC deputy, Salar Ali Azamayee as IRGC Navy commander and Kiumarth Heidari as deputy chief of staff. Iran International and Jerusalem Post reported Hossein Taeb's return to lead the Basij and Mohsen Rezaei's return to a top security post, while Defa Press framed the moves as post-war defence reorganisation.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and US-Iran posture
threads.summary: Iran International reported parliament advancing a bill restricting US and Israeli transit through the Strait of Hormuz, while Trump said the US Navy controls the waterway and had swept it for Iranian mines. Trump also demanded Iranian compensation for IRGC-linked attacks on US citizens, and Jerusalem Post analysts framed Hormuz as leverage tied to a June 17 memorandum.

threads.label: Mecca Pact regional realignment
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Iranian foreign ministry spokesman Baghaei dismissing concerns about the new Saudi-Pakistan-Turkey Mecca Joint Defense Agreement, with Iran International noting Tehran playing the pact down publicly. Jerusalem Post analysis argued the Houthi strike on Jizan exposed limits of the pact's collective deterrence.

threads.label: Lebanon front and Israel-Lebanon talks
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Israel and Lebanon set for talks in early September, while flagging continued Hezbollah civilian-arm activity in Zawtar al-Gharbiyeh per Alma Research Center. Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesperson condemned Israeli attacks in southern Lebanon, and the FCDO updated Lebanon travel advice.

threads.label: Gaza Board of Peace plan and stabilisation force
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported the Ugandan Parliament approving UPDF deployment to Gaza as part of Trump's proposed international stabilisation force, alongside Meir Amit Institute analysis that the Board of Peace's Hamas-disarmament agreement would restrict Israeli operational latitude. Hamas-affiliated analysts predicted Israel would be pressured to accept the 15-point plan, and the IDF urged Gaza residents to swap old banknotes.

threads.label: Yemen escalation warning
threads.summary: UN envoy Hans Grundberg warned via the Secretary-General's spokesperson that Yemen faces the greatest risk of renewed large-scale conflict since the April 2022 truce. The Security Council issued a press statement on Yemen, while IRIB relayed reports of Yemeni missile and drone attacks on Saudi-aligned forces in Marib and al-Mukha.

threads.label: Iran domestic strain
threads.summary: Iran International reported workers across mining, industrial and municipal sectors going months without full pay alongside layoffs, and the arrest of a football fan-page operator over protest-themed posts. Jerusalem Post cited growing fears of wider conflict, labour unrest and execution protests, while IRIB carried a parliamentary claim of a 45-trillion-toman violation in feed imports.

events.summary: با صدور حکمی از سوی حضرت آیت‌الله خامنه‌ای صورت گرفت 📝 انتصاب سردار سرلشکر مصطفی ایزدی به سِمت جانشین فرمانده کل سپاه پاسداران 💬 حضرت آیت‌الله سیّدمجتبی حسینی خامنه‌ای، فرمانده‌ی معظّم کل قوا در حکمی سردار سرلشکر پاسدار مصطفی ایزدی را به سِمت جانشین فرمانده کل سپاه پاسداران انقلاب اسلامی منصوب کردند. 🔻 متن حکم فرمانده‌ی معظّم کل قوا بدین شرح است: ✏️ بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم سردار سرلشکر پاسدار مصطفی ایزدی نظر به تعهد، شایستگی و تجارب ارزنده‌تان، و به پیشنهاد فرمانده کل سپاه، شما را به سِمت جانشین فرمانده کل سپاه پاسداران انقلاب اسلامی منصوب می‌کنم. ایفای نقش جهادی در ارتقاء سطح آمادگی‌های سازمان
events.title_en: Issued by decree from His Eminence Ayatollah Khamenei. Appointment of General Mostafa Izadi as Deputy Commander-in-Chief of the IRGC. His Eminence Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Husseini Khamenei, Commander-in-Chief, appointed General Pasdar Mostafa Izadi as Deputy Commander-in-Chief of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps. The text of the Commander-in-Chief's decree is as follows: In the name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful. General Pasdar Mostafa Izadi. Given your commitment, qualification and valuable experience, and based on the proposal of the Commander of the IRGC, I appoint you as Deputy Commander-in-Chief of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps of the Islamic Revolution. Performing a jihadi role in raising the level of preparedness of the organisation

In view of the glorious and honourable martyrdom of Commander Brigadier Shahid Seyyed Abdolrahim Mousavi at the hands of the Zionist-American enemy, and given your worthy service and valuable experience, I hereby appoint you as Chief of Staff of the Armed Forces.
